ctx.x: I don't remember. He was a big band trumpet player.

I might, yes. I'm pretty sure I'm right. I might be a little cloudy, but my name was Lavedan. She always used her maiden name. And Lucienne Lavedan, who played with the operands, she used to do some of the things with the symphony. I'm fairly certain that they had been married, and this girl would have been the daughter of that union. I think he went to Warren Easton. I think
